description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Tracks individual migration tasks for SupplyChain Frontend.

tasks.description: Upgrade from Spring Boot 2.7.18 (Java 8) to Spring Boot 3.x (Java 21)
tasks.reason: Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18 are end-of-life. The assessment report identifies these as mandatory issues for Azure migration (azure-java-version-02000, spring-boot-to-azure-spring-boot-version-01000, spring-framework-version-01000).
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to latest 3.x. Includes Java 8 to 21 upgrade, javax.* to jakarta.* namespace migration (Jakarta EE), and Spring Framework 5.x to 6.x upgrade. Update JSTL dependency from javax.servlet:jstl to jakarta.servlet.jstl. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with the new versions.

tasks.description: Validate and fix CVE vulnerabilities in project dependencies
tasks.reason: User explicitly requested all CVE issues to be fixed to ensure secure deployment on Azure.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVE vulnerabilities. Upgrade affected dependencies to patched versions. Ensure no critical or high-severity CVEs remain after remediation.

tasks.description: Update Dockerfile for Java 21 and Azure Container Apps deployment readiness
tasks.reason: The existing Dockerfile uses Java 8 and Tomcat 8.5 base images which are incompatible with the upgraded application. Azure Container Apps requires an updated container image.
tasks.requirements: Update the multi-stage Dockerfile to use Java 21-compatible base images. Ensure the container builds and runs correctly with the upgraded application. The Dockerfile currently uses maven:3.8-openjdk-8 (build) and tomcat:8.5-jdk8 (runtime).
